claims.quote: Saquon Barkley is out for Sunday's tilt against the Jacksonville Jaguars, but when might the Philadelphia Eagles running back return?

news.headline: Questionable (Hamstring)
news.detail: Barkley was inactive for this past Sunday's loss to the Jaguars in London due to a hamstring injury suffered one week prior, but head coach Nick Sirianni told Zach Berman of The Athletic on Monday that he's "hopeful" the running back will gain clearance to play in Week 6 against the Panthers.
